subtitle: 回溯一年、每日更新：只保留对 AI C端产品、购物智能体和对话导购有产品启发的信息。

linkRepair: 2026-09-14: decoded Google News RSS links to original publishers, repaired historical Google Search fallback links, and disabled future Google Search fallbacks for article cards.
competitorCoverage: Expanded domestic competitor tracking for Taobao/Tmall/Qwen, Meituan Xiaomei/Wenxiaotuan, JD Jingyan/Yanxi/Jingmai, Dewu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin Ecommerce and Pinduoduo, covering both C-end shopping entry points and B-end merchant tools.
blockedUnstableSources: Filtered ebrun.com, ttplus.cn and low-signal market tickers from future automatic updates because they produced unstable links or off-topic cards.
contentTypeFilter: Added article-level contentType for filtering: 竞品、产品功能、行业新闻、深度观点、技术/协议、商家生态、研究数据。
